coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 10 ground-truth items: MPE Simple Spread, steps-per-second, JaxMARL, the original CPU-based implementation (PettingZoo), one environment, and throughput measured under random actions.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the required NVIDIA A100 GPU and AMD EPYC 7763 processor with a CPU-only Intel setup. Explicitly excludes batching, omitting the required 100- and 10,000-parallel-environment configurations. Instead, it varies agent counts and loop modes, so it cannot evaluate the intended parallel-environment scaling.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to conclude that JaxMARL significantly outperforms the original CPU-based implementation and scales efficiently as the number of parallel environments increases.
